summary: Use books, rooms and branching passages to express discovery while making any information-system metaphor explicit.
objective: The viewer can find the main reading space and any graph/data meaning has a legend rather than relying on guessed symbolism.
intent_signals: Set the scene in a dreamlike library
Use dream library as the narrative setting
example_prompts: Create a dream library where branching shelves represent labeled research topics and transform without losing identity.

principles: Use books, rooms and branching passages to express discovery while making any information-system metaphor explicit.
Theme supplies setting and motifs; choose geometry style, rendering approach and factual model independently.
implementation: Vary shelf and stair silhouettes around one organizing space; choose a single impossible transformation rather than making every surface unrelated.
Contrast quiet book masses with a few illuminated reading spaces; use material rhythm to distinguish floor, shelf and passage.
Lead the camera through a readable spatial reveal; shelves that represent data keep stable identities when reorganized.
observable_checks: The viewer can find the main reading space and any graph/data meaning has a legend rather than relying on guessed symbolism.
Inspect one focal object close up and the complete route or spatial relationship from an overview.

known_limits: Authored fictional setting guidance; no rendered artifact or runtime improvement has been observed for this record.
This proposal does not establish historical, cultural, scientific or engineering facts.
creative_affordances: Combine with surreal, papercraft or cinematic staging; invented library geometry is not a valid map of a real information architecture unless declared.
Replace motifs or combine settings to suit the user brief; maintain a readable organizing idea rather than treating these suggestions as a fixed asset list.
